thread:
maria-sales: SparrowBank wants a 7-day POC. Requirements: Okta SSO (SP-initiated), SCIM (bulk seed + delta), RBAC mapping, and domain verification across 3 subdomains (two in same zone, one on a different provider). They sent a security questionnaire and want a Dedicated trial quote. Need: SCIM rate limits for POC, domain TXT consolidation options, delegated admin scope, and what we include in the security packet. @trent-se @zhou-eng

trent-se: Quick answers: SAML SP-initiated supported; we can ingest metadata via URL or XML upload. SCIM 2.0 supported: bulk endpoint for seeding + PATCH-based delta for updates. Group->role mapping supported and we can enforce an allowlist so only certain groups provision roles.

zhou-eng: SCIM details: delta uses PATCH ops and returns only changed resources. For migrations best practice: bulk import with pageSize ~500-1000, then enable delta webhooks for live sync. Hosted default throttle is 60 req/s; for short POCs ops can temporarily raise this. Small example PATCH accepted: PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id} {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"active","value":true}]}

trent-se: Note: if Okta includes many groups in SAML assertions, assertion size can grow; prefer SCIM groups for large orgs.

yoel-ops: Domain verification: we issue a TXT token per domain/subdomain. For the two subdomains in the same DNS zone we can offer a consolidated TXT (single record) if their DNS admin is okay; the third subdomain in a different provider will need its own TXT. We do not support wildcard apex verification. Verification usually clears within minutes after propagation; plan for a 24h buffer. If SparrowBank gives temporary DNS access we can run the verification ourselves to speed things up.

maria-sales: Delegated admin ask: can customer create tenant-scoped admins who manage SCIM, SSO, and domain claims?

trent-se: Yes. For Dedicated/Private we expose tenant-scoped admin roles that can manage SSO settings, SCIM toggles, group allowlists, and request domain claims. For Hosted tenant admins can manage most settings; final TXT verification can be automated or run by our ops depending on their preference.

liz-legal: Security packet: provide SOC2 Type II summary, pen-test executive summary, encryption-at-rest + KMS note, network isolation whitepaper (for Dedicated), SAML endpoints & recommended attributes, SCIM scope & retention, and our standard DPA. If they return the filled questionnaire we'll answer and flag anything needing legal redlines.

maria-sales: Pricing: they prefer Dedicated trial if cost fits. Rough ballpark for their expected POC load (~120k tokens/day, moderate concurrency) 1: $2,400/week for a 7-day Dedicated trial (includes elevated SCIM throttle). I'll ask sales-ops for a formal quote.

karen-cust: Thanks team 1: we'll send IdP metadata, a sample SAML assertion, a test SCIM token + one test user, and DNS zone info. Can you confirm consolidated TXT will be acceptable if our DNS provider supports it?

yoel-ops: Yes, consolidated TXT for subdomains under the same zone is acceptable with ops approval. Send DNS provider + zone owner contact and we can prepare values.

calendar-bot: Created event "SparrowBank POC kickoff - SSO/SCIM" Fri 9:00 AM (30m) with #sales, @trent-se, @zhou-eng, @liz-legal.

maria-sales: Great. I'll follow up with the checklist and formal quote EOD. :thumbsup:
